title: Hezo Link pending check response V1
description: Strict public wire structure for one Pending Check Response V1. It validates structure only and defines no endpoint, HTTP status, polling behavior, token issuance, entropy proof, TTL, retention, storage, or network behavior.

check_token.description: Canonical unpadded base64url encoding shape for exactly 32 bytes. Structural validation does not prove randomness, entropy, issuance, ownership, purpose, or storage behavior.

retry_after_ms.description: Bounded positive integer wire value only; it does not define or promise polling behavior.

expires_at.description: Canonical real UTC whole-second instant in years 0001 through 9999. Validators must assert the date-time format; this value alone defines no TTL or retention policy.

request_id.description: Nonempty bounded ASCII request identifier shape.
